auth.sub_setup: No users yet. Create this installation's initial administrator.
auth.sub_login: Sign in with your e-mail and password.
auth.sub_reautenticar: Your session expired. Sign in again to pick up where you left off.
auth.indisponivel: Could not reach the server. Your session was kept.
view.conta.sub: Your details, password, language and the devices where you are signed in.
conta.senha_sub: Changing the password ends your other sessions; this one stays.
conta.senha_nao_confere: The confirmation does not match the new password.
conta.idioma_sub: Applies to this browser and is saved to your account.
conta.sessoes_sub: Where you are signed in. End anything you do not recognize.
pwa.nova_versao: New version available — reload the page.
pwa.dica_ios: On iPhone/iPad: tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".
vis.hint: Private: only you and administrators. Group: you and your user group. Public: every user. You can change it later.
vis.hint_privada: Only you and administrators can see it
vis.hint_grupo: You and your user group can see it
vis.sem_grupo: you are not in any group
config.sem_dono_visibilidade.hint: Queries, plannings and demands created by an API token or before the first sign-in have no owner. Who sees them: administrators only (default), one user group, or everyone. Applies immediately.
config.sem_dono_grupo_id.hint: Used only when the option above is "One user group".
config.push_contato.hint: E-mail or URL Praxis identifies itself with to the push services (Google, Mozilla, Apple) when sending notifications — they use it to report abuse. Empty: the first administrator's e-mail.
view.home.sub: This month at a glance: spend, active demands, and what needs you.
view.kanban.sub: Each column is a status. Drag a card to reorder priority; state transitions happen through the card's buttons.
view.demandas.sub: Each demand runs on its own branch. Open the card to follow the phases and the live log.
view.nova.sub: Pick the project and paste the PRD or describe the ticket. The demand is born as a conversation — everything stays in the chat until it becomes a plan.
view.consultas.sub: Ask how the system behaves — to write PRDs, understand routines, or build a customer strategy. The consultant analyzes the code and answers in business language, without exposing source code.
view.consultas.selecione: Select a query on the left or start a new one.
view.planejamentos.sub: Work with the strategist to turn a need into a PRD and/or ADRs ready to become a demand — with a visual presentation and prototype whenever you want.
view.planejamentos.selecione: Select a planning on the left or start a new one.
view.projetos.sub: Register the project folder and its parameters. Anything not set here inherits from the global settings.
view.projetos.selecione: Select a project on the left or register a new one.
view.grupos.sub: Group the repositories of a single solution (e.g. "Vulcano Chat"). In queries, the group's first project is the main repository and the others come in as extra context. A project can belong to several groups.
view.grupos.selecione: Select a group on the left or create a new one.
view.motores.sub: Order by priority — if the first one's quota runs out, the next takes over (automatic fallback). Use ▲/▼ to reorder.
view.config.sub: Apply to every project that doesn't define its own override.
view.config.notificacoes_sub: Send Praxis events to Telegram, Discord, Slack, Google Chat, or your own webhook. Configure the channels and the events notified by default — each project can customize which ones it receives.
view.config.tokens_sub: For the ticketing system and integrations. The value is shown only once, at creation.
view.usuarios.sub: Register who uses this Praxis and define what each person can do. Basic access is always view-only; roles grant the other capabilities.
view.usuarios.selecione: Select a user on the left or register a new one.
view.papeis.sub: A role is a set of permissions from the catalog. Assign roles to users on the Users screen.
view.papeis.selecione: Select a role on the left or create a new one.
view.gusuarios.sub: Each group defines the engine and model used in its members' Queries — you can give product and support a lighter/cheaper model, since queries only explain behavior (they don't produce production code). Assign users to a group on the Users screen.
view.gusuarios.selecione: Select a group on the left or create a new one.
view.manual.sub: How to use Praxis Autonomous day to day.
home.sem_gastos: No spend recorded in this window.
kanban.nenhuma_demanda: No demands for the current filters.
config.motor_preferido.hint: Engine tried first on executions. On “Default”, the engines’ priority order applies; the list shows the active engines.
config.execucoes_simultaneas.hint: Demands running at the same time across the whole machine (all projects).
config.execucoes_por_projeto.hint: Cap on demands from the same project running in parallel, within the global limit.
config.gates_simultaneos.hint: Heavy builds/tests running in parallel — 1 avoids saturating the machine.
config.max_correcoes.hint: Fixer rounds when the gates fail, before the phase is marked as failed.
config.max_ciclos_revisao.hint: Fix rounds after the reviewer rejects the phase.
config.git_sufixo_praxis: “ - Praxis” suffix on the commit author
config.git_sufixo_praxis.hint: Marks commits made by Praxis in the author name, keeping the e-mail of whoever requested the demand.
config.gates.hint: One command per line. Run after each phase; the phase only completes with all of them green.
config.uso_intervalo_min.hint: How often Praxis checks each engine profile's quota (default 5 minutes; minimum 1). Applies without restarting the service.
config.idioma.hint: Language of events, notifications, and content generated without a user (pt-BR, en, es, or zh-CN). The UI follows each user's preference.
config.sessao_jwt_min.hint: Lifetime of the JWT the browser keeps only in memory; the session renews it automatically for as long as it lasts (default 60 minutes). Applies to the next sign-ins and renewals.
config.sessao_inatividade_dias.hint: How many days without opening Praxis until the browser session expires. The deadline slides on every use: daily users are never signed out (default 30).
config.sessao_maxima_dias.hint: Absolute cap since sign-in, even in continuous use; once reached, asks to sign in again (default 90).
consultas.nenhuma: No queries yet. Start a new one.
consultas.sem_projetos: No projects registered. Ask an administrator to register one under Projects.
consultas.ph_pergunta: What do you want to understand? E.g.: "How does receivables settlement work?", "I need to draft a PRD to improve the dunning sequence", "How do I deploy Vulcano Chat for a customer with two branches?"
consultas.iniciada: Query started — the consultant is analyzing.
consultas.hint_grupo: In a group, the consultant sees every repository of the solution.
consultas.hint_pergunta: It doesn't need to be technical: if context is missing, the consultant asks questions before answering.
consultas.confirmar_excluir: Delete this query and the whole conversation?
consultas.ph_resposta: Reply to the consultant or ask another question… (Shift+Enter for a new line)
consultas.analisando_aviso: The consultant is analyzing the code — this may take a few minutes.
consultas.aguarde: The consultant is still analyzing — wait for the answer.
consultas.turno_falhou: Last turn failed: {erro} — you can resend your question.
consultas.responda_abaixo: Answer in the field below so the consultant can continue.
consultas.redigido: Technical excerpts were removed by the security policy.
consultas.title_anexar: Attach files to the query (emails, screenshots, spreadsheets…)
consultas.hint_anexos: Attach the material the consultant should take into account: customer email, error screenshot, case spreadsheet, PRD draft… (md, txt, csv, json, pdf, html, xml, tx2, or image · up to 15 MB each)
consultas.hint_formatos: md, txt, csv, json, pdf, html, xml, tx2, or image · up to 15 MB each
consultas.sem_arquivos: No files attached yet. Attach the customer email, an error screenshot or any material that helps the consultant understand the case.
consultas.hint_arquivos_leitura: Files live in the query folder as read-only input: the consultant reads them but never changes them.
consultas.anexados: {n} file(s) attached — the consultant will see them on the next turn.
consultas.anexados_cite: {n} file(s) attached — mention them in your message to guide the consultant.
consultas.falha_anexar_segue: Failed to attach {arquivo}: {erro} — the query continues without this file.
configx.hint_branco: Fields left on “Default” are not stored — the system value shown in the option applies.
configx.hint_cabecalho: Fixed line at the top of every notification — useful to identify the environment.
configx.hint_eventos: Apply to every project that doesn't customize its notifications.
configx.informe_nome: Enter a name for the token.
configx.token_criado: Token created — copy it now, it will not be shown again:
nova.cadastre_antes: Register a project before creating a demand. Go to
nova.ph_titulo: Optional — if empty, we use the PRD's first line
nova.ph_prd: Paste the PRD here or describe the ticket…
nova.hint_branch: If blank, we generate praxis/d<id>-<title>. The praxis/ prefix is always added.
nova.plan_antes: Prefer to build the PRD first? Start with a
nova.plan_depois: — the strategist reads the code, polishes the document with you, and creates the demand from there.
nova.cole_prd: Paste the PRD or describe the ticket before creating the demand.
projetos.ph_slug: derived from the name if blank
projetos.pasta_hint: Must be a git repository. Demand worktrees are created outside this folder, under %PRAXIS_HOME%\worktrees.
seletor_pasta.titulo: Pick a folder on the server
seletor_pasta.sub: Browse the folders of the machine where Praxis is running.
seletor_pasta.filtro_ph: filter the folders in this list…
seletor_pasta.aviso_repo: This folder is a git repository.
seletor_pasta.aviso_nao_repo: This folder has no .git — it only works if it is a subfolder of a git repository.
seletor_pasta.truncado: Too many subfolders: showing only the first ones. Type the path to go straight there.
projetos.add_dirs_hint: Extra repositories the agent may edit. One path per line.
projetos.sec_notificacoes_sub: which events notify in this project
projetos.notif_personalizar_hint: Unchecked: uses the system default events. Checked: choose below which events of this project notify.
projetos.notif_padrao: Notifications reverted to the system default.
projetos.acesso_sem_restricao: No restriction: every authenticated user can see this project.
projetos.acesso_restrito: Restricted: only the selected groups/users (plus administrators or whoever manages projects) can see this project, its demands, and its queries.
projetos.overview_ph: System purpose, domain, main modules, business flows… (markdown, no code)
projetos.overview_vazio: No overview yet — this project's queries will have less context.
projetos.overview_gerando: Generating the overview in the background — it takes a few minutes. Use "Reload" to see the result.
projetos.override_numero: "{rotulo}" must be a number (or check "inherit from global").
projetos.efetiva_vazia: No config key defined (everything on the system default).
projetos.efetiva_hint: Global resolution × this project's override (origin shows where each key came from).
projetos.efetiva_falha: Failed to fetch the effective config: {erro}
grupos.nenhum: No groups yet. Create one for solutions with several repositories.
grupos.ph_descricao: What this solution is, in business terms (goes into the consultant's context).
grupos.sem_membros: No repository in the group yet.
grupos.membro_obrigatorio: Add at least one repository to the group.
grupos.confirmar_exclusao: Delete the group? The QUERIES linked to it will also be deleted.
grupos.repositorios_hint: The first one is the main repository for queries; use ▲/▼ to reorder.
demandas.nenhuma_filtros: No demands found with the current filters.
demandas.chat_ph: Add to the demand… (Shift+Enter for a new line)
demandas.perg_banner_editavel: The analyst read the code and generated the questions below. Suggestions come pre-filled — confirm or adjust them and generate the plan.
demandas.responder_tudo: Answer everything and generate the plan →
demandas.editar_codigo_title: Opens VS Code in the browser, right in this worktree (requires the demand to be paused, failed, in conflict, or closed).
demandas.sem_conflitos: ✓ No conflicts with main — ready to integrate.
demandas.integr_indisponivel: Integration becomes available when the demand completes.
demandas.vscode_local_title: Requires Praxis running on THIS machine and VS Code installed.
demandas.fases_vazio: This demand has no phases yet.
demandas.fase_humana_banner: ✋ This demand has phase(s) that require human intervention. Do the phase's work and click “Mark as done ✓” to unblock execution.
demandas.marcar_feito_title: Completes this phase manually and unblocks the execution of the next ones.
demandas.reiniciar_title: Stops the run in progress, throws away all work done in this phase and restarts it from scratch.
demandas.reiniciar_confirmar: Restart phase {codigo} from scratch? The run in progress is stopped and all work done in this phase is discarded — including what was saved from earlier attempts.
demandas.plano_banner: The planner generated the plan below. Adjust the phases (title, code, dependencies, requires human), save and approve to execute — or reject with a comment to replan.
demandas.plano_sem_fases: No phases. Add at least one before approving.
demandas.rejeitar_prompt: What should change in the plan? (the planner will redo it based on this comment)
demandas.log_conectado: Live streaming (SSE) · full log saved in the database.
demandas.log_interrompido: Log connection lost — trying to reconnect…
motores.uso_hint: Today/7 days/Total: usage recorded by Praxis (runs · estimated cost · tokens). Quota: read from the vendor CLI when available — Claude does not expose /usage headlessly.
motores.det_modelo_harness: uses the model configured in the harness itself
motores.hint_modelo_consulta: Used in the Queries chat (product/support). Rigor can be lower than analysis/execution — it can be a lighter/cheaper model. User groups can override.
motores.hint_fallback: On, the engine joins the automatic switch chain when quota runs out (all profiles of the previous engine are exhausted first). Off, the engine only runs where chosen manually — the project's preferred engine or the user group's engine in queries.
motores.params_objeto: params must be a JSON object
motores.ph_config_dir: optional directory; empty = managed by Praxis
motores.hint_perfis_login: Each profile keeps its own credentials. Praxis distributes flows deterministically across active profiles and applies the same directory at login and in runs.
motores.hint_perfis_sem_login: Assisted login and full isolation are available in this increment only for Claude and Codex.
motores.copie_url_menu: Copy the URL via the link's context menu.
motores.ph_codigo: paste here the code shown by Claude
motores.perfil_removido: Profile removed. The directory and credentials were preserved on the server.
planejamentos.nenhum: No plannings yet. Start a new one.
planejamentos.ph_necessidade: Describe the need. E.g.: "We need a self-service portal for reissuing invoices", "Define the architecture for integrating with the new payment gateway".
planejamentos.falha_anexar_segue: Failed to attach {nome}: {erro} — the planning continues without this file.
planejamentos.iniciado: Planning started — the strategist is working.
planejamentos.hint_grupo: In a group, the strategist sees every repository of the solution.
planejamentos.hint_necessidade: It doesn't need to be polished: the strategist reads the code and asks questions before closing the document. You can change the focus and the visual level at any time.
planejamentos.hint_anexos: Attach the material the strategist should build on: meeting transcript, an ADR from another project, drafts… (md, txt, csv, json, pdf, html, xml, tx2, or image · up to 15 MB each)
planejamentos.confirmar_excluir: Delete this planning, with its documents and artifacts?
planejamentos.prefs_atualizadas: Preferences updated — they apply from the next turn.
planejamentos.hint_etapas: Work in stages: the PO can close the PRD and later the architect switches "Produce" to PRD + ADRs and continues in this same conversation — the documents remain.
planejamentos.ph_resposta: Reply to the strategist or ask for document adjustments… (Shift+Enter for a new line)
planejamentos.refs_anexadas_cite.one: {n} reference attached — mention it in your message to guide the strategist.
planejamentos.refs_anexadas_cite.other: {n} references attached — mention them in your message to guide the strategist.
planejamentos.pensando_aviso: The strategist is reading the code and working on the documents — this may take a few minutes.
planejamentos.aguarde: The strategist is still working — wait for the answer.
planejamentos.hint_reprocessar: Reprocesses the current conversation, no need to resend the message.
planejamentos.falha_demandas: Failed to load the planning's demands: {erro}
planejamentos.drift_nao_registrado: The revision delivered to the last demand was not recorded (link predates this version) — compare via the Documents tab.
planejamentos.drift_prd: the PRD is at revision {atual} (demand #{id} received {entregue})
planejamentos.drift_adrs: the ADRs are at revision {atual} (demand #{id} received {entregue})
planejamentos.drift_sem_mudancas: The documents haven't changed since the last demand was created.
planejamentos.demanda_ativa_aviso: ⚠ Demand #{id} is still active. Creating another demand from the same plan may produce overlapping work — the Kanban flags when two demands touch the same files.
planejamentos.demanda_criada: Demand #{id} created — the analyst is already reading the PRD.
planejamentos.hint_nova_completa: The new demand carries the WHOLE current document (full demand). The incremental demand — only what evolved since a delivery — arrives in a future version.
planejamentos.criar_do_documento: Create a demand from the current document
planejamentos.sem_docs: No documents yet — the strategist creates them as the conversation progresses.
planejamentos.sem_arts: No visual artifacts yet. At the Presentation and Prototype levels, the strategist generates them along with the document.
planejamentos.hint_sandbox: Artifacts open in a new tab, isolated in a sandbox — they have no access to your Praxis session.
planejamentos.refs_anexadas.one: {n} reference attached — the strategist will see it next turn.
planejamentos.refs_anexadas.other: {n} references attached — the strategist will see them next turn.
planejamentos.hint_formatos: md, txt, csv, json, pdf, html, xml, tx2, or image · up to 15 MB each
planejamentos.sem_refs: No references yet. Attach an ADR from another project, a meeting transcript, or any material the strategist should build on.
planejamentos.hint_refs_leitura: References live in the planning's folder as read-only input: the strategist consults them but never changes them.
planejamentos.responda_abaixo: Answer in the field below so the strategist can continue.
notif.ev_codigo_acessado: Code opened in the web IDE
notif.hint_telegram: Create a bot with @BotFather to get the token; the chat_id is the destination (use @userinfobot).
notif.hint_discord: The channel's webhook URL (Channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks).
notif.hint_slack: URL of a workspace Incoming Webhook.
notif.hint_google_chat: Webhook URL of the space (Manage webhooks).
notif.hint_webhook: POST with JSON body {titulo, texto}. Optional header in the "Name: value" format (e.g. authentication).
usuarios.grupo_hint: Defines the engine/model for this user's Queries. Manage the groups on the User groups screen.
usuarios.confirmar_excluir: Delete the user {email}? This action cannot be undone.
usuarios.papel_sistema_hint: System role: it cannot be edited or removed (grants full access).
usuarios.confirmar_excluir_papel: Delete the role "{nome}"? Linked users lose these permissions.
gusuarios.confirmar_excluir: Delete the group "{nome}"? Linked users go back to the default query engine.
gusuarios.hint_precedencia: Model precedence: group model → engine's query model → analysis model. Members are linked on the Users screen.
